concerns.text: FR-005 requires automatic mean-centering of predictors if VIF > 5 to mitigate multicollinearity. Task T022 only implements VIF calculation and flagging (T023) but lacks a task to implement the corrective re-fitting loop required by the spec's Edge Cases and FR-005.

FR-009 distinguishes between 'halt' (core constructs missing >10%) and 'reduced model' (covariates missing >10%). Task T022 logic description conflates these, stating 'DO NOT REMOVE' wm_metric but failing to explicitly task the implementation of the conditional reduced-model logic for covariates as mandated by FR-009.

SC-004 defines instability as CI crossing zero in >50% of 'defined threshold sweeps' (5 specific values). Task T029 generates a full cross-combination (25 points) and T030 calculates instability over this larger set. No task exists to implement the specific logic required by SC-004 to evaluate only the 5 defined sweeps or to map the cross-combination results back to the specific SC-004 metric.

SC-002 requires checking if the primary effect is significant (p < 0.05) BEFORE applying the 'no crossing zero' stability check. Task T028 generates the CI but lacks a specific task step to implement the conditional logic that gates the stability check on the primary significance result.

FR-008 requires a structured halt with a specific log file (`halt_log.json`) if core constructs are missing. Task T013 Step 6 mentions writing this file but primarily describes raising `SystemExit(1)`. A distinct task or explicit step is missing to ensure the 'graceful stop' and structured logging behavior required by FR-008 is implemented before the crash.

FR-009 mandates a reduced model if missing covariates cause a drop >10%. Task T013 Step 4 implements a 'reduced model' flag only if missingness >5% (row-wise). The task logic threshold (5%) contradicts the spec requirement (10%) and lacks a task to implement the correct 10% threshold logic for covariates.
